messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT CREATED: gpu_pool_exhaustion_usw2 - 2034506789
incident-bot: Symptoms: request queue growth on hosted inference (us-west-2 spot pool), 429 throttles rising, autoscaler failing to allocate GPUs (OOM/scale limit?). Notifying oncall.
maria (oncall): saw alerts — queue depth 18k, p50 latency spiking from 120ms -> 900ms, error rate 3.8% (was 0.2%).
chris (infra): looking at autoscaler logs now. initial glance: gce API quota errors + pod eviction churn. posting tail:```ERROR Autoscaler: failed to create instance: quotaExceeded: "GPUS_PER_PROJECT"```
sasha (sre): are we still prioritizing spot pools here? if spot is drained we should failover to Dedicated pools per fallback policy. what does routing show?
denise (prod): customer reports: a few enterprise customers seeing 5xxs for model streaming endpoints. values: ~200 affected keys for last 5m. Not fully panicked yet but raising support tickets.
maria (oncall): created bridge: https://bridge.internal/r/2034506789 (join if oncall) — I'll mute noisy non-essentials.
chris (infra): confirmed spot pool preemptions spike + project GPU quota exhausted. Autoscaler tried to create nodes, got quota errors then backed off. Scaling back-off window is 5m.
sasha (sre): switching routing policy to prefer dedicated fallback for critical SKUs. Maria, can you apply temporary routing override? command: `/routing override --pool=dedicated-usw2 --selector=critical=true --duration=30m`
maria (oncall): running override now. output: `OK override applied, gradual drain from spot->dedicated triggered`
denise (prod): ETA to see traffic shift?
sasha (sre): should be gradual over 1-2 minutes; we'll still have queue while KV caches warm. Watch for 429s to drop.
maria (oncall): 2m in — 429 rate dropped from 18% -> 7%. queue down to 6.2k. good sign.
chris (infra): requesting quota increase with cloud provider but slow. temp mitigation: enabling burst capacity on Reserved GPU pool and disabling autoscaler backoff to allow immediate allocations. Doing `kubectl patch` to bump max nodes for reserved-gpu-pool.
sasha (sre): be careful with cost — but okay for 30m emergency. maria keep an eye on cost alarms.
maria (oncall): reserved pool bumped + burst enabled. Logs show new nodes provisioning. p95 latency trending down.
denise (prod): posting customer update: "We're investigating increased latencies and throttles for inference in us-west-2. We've applied temporary routing to dedicated capacity and expect recovery in the next 10-20 minutes. We'll update in 15." :thumbsup:
chris (infra): autoscaler error root cause: simultaneous job of reclaiming preempted GPUs created heavy API churning. switch to exponential backoff and serialized create should help. Opening infra ticket: INFRA-4392.
sasha (sre): implementing serialized creation patch now (hotfix) — applying to controlled region. patch snippet:```diff
- createNodes(parallel=true)
+ createNodes(parallel=false)
```
maria (oncall): hotfix applied. queue 1.1k, 429s now 0.9%. We should start throttling low-priority sync jobs while recovery completes — can we set policy?
sasha (sre): enabling low-priority throttle: `/policy set throttle --group=background-batch --rate=5r/s` — applied.
chris (infra): cloud provider responded on quota request: soft-limit increase pending approval 30-45m. We'll keep reserved burst until then.
denise (prod): coordinating with support: list of impacted customers attached in the bridge notes. One enterprise had a critical stream; ops PM pinged legal for SLA note.
oncall-rotation: noted handoff at 2034510400 (in ~1 hr). Maria, if you need me to take extended oncall let me know.
maria (oncall): plan for next 60m: monitor queue metrics, keep reserved burst, leave routing override for critical=true, follow up infra ticket for autoscaler bug. If queue < 200 for 10m, start rolling back overrides.
sasha (sre): postmortem action items being tracked: 1) increase quota buffer for spot to dedicated failover 2) autoscaler serialization + smarter backoff 3) route fallback test during maintenance 4) playbook add for rapid reserved burst enablement.
maria (oncall): current status 30m after start: queue 120, throttles <0.2%, new nodes stable. marking incident as mitigated but keeping bridge open for follow-up.
chris (infra): INFRA-4392 created, assigned to me. linking logs + commit that introduced parallel create.
denise (prod): final customer update posted, support ticket batch sent. will follow up with affected accounts.
oncall-rotation: I'll take the official oncall handoff at 2034510400 and track rollback. everyone please add notes to the bridge.
maria (oncall): thanks all — great triage. closing incident channel to alerts; will reopen if regressions appear. :tada:
